## Specific task description

Task instruction: Shake the blue-capped plastic bottle horizontally after grabbing.

Task description: The target is the clear plastic bottle with a blue cap lying horizontally at the front left of the table. Grasp it and shake it back and forth parallel to the tabletop.

Success criteria: Pick up the bottle, lift it clearly off the table, and shake it horizontally back and forth while holding it.

## Execution tips

- Grasp the relatively straight, uniformly thick areas on opposite sides around the middle of the bottle. Avoid the narrowing shoulder, cap, and rounded base to increase finger-pad contact and reduce slipping while moving.
- During approach, place the fingers on opposite sides of the bottle's long axis and open slightly wider than the selected section. Confirm the pads surround the body before closing rather than pressing only its top and causing rolling.
- Make a small test lift to observe whether the bottle body slips or rotates. If a regrasp is needed, first let the bottle rest on the table to avoid releasing it unsupported.
- Leave clearance for the full back-and-forth swept range of cap, bottom and gripper, avoiding upright containers and the black round object behind. Reverse smoothly to reduce inertia-induced slipping.
